entries.why: Joined child-process exit observer, not detached pipeline work. The supervisor awaits it and kills its owned process group in finally, even if the root child already exited. SIGKILL of the entire pod leaves the durable owner and unchanged Redis silence fence for the existing Cloud Tasks redrive. test_sync_worker_execution.py proves lease loss and root crash stop the descendant before handoff.

Redis token renewal is scoped to one awaited pipeline and stopped/joined in finally. Renewal rejection cancels execution, retains the lock, and exits the isolated job process; the parent reaps every process-group member. Existing 1800s TTL and token-fenced pipeline writes prevent overlap with fallback. The cancelled-worker lock/custody and process-group death proofs are in test_sync_worker_execution.py.

Dedicated pull-process lifecycle, not post-response pipeline work. The poll loop is stopped and joined during lifespan shutdown. At S2 it executes no audio; an unexpected accepted lease is handed back. Losing the process at SIGKILL retains the durable sequencer reservation and named Cloud Tasks fallback, recovered through the unchanged 1800s owner lease. Empty authenticated pulls and interruptible shutdown are exercised by test_sync_worker_runtime.py.

PR #23828: saturation admission retry for the already-inventoried best-effort episode finalize/intake overlay hooks in this module. Runs on the same pool with at most 64 deferred calls and synchronous producer backpressure. No source processing authority is delegated: transcript/audio/job/task/memory persistence precedes the hook. SIGKILL or shutdown cancellation can leave derived notes or episode attachment stale; a later finalize/close can repair from retained transcripts. This site and the executor admission implementation are both inventoried; future retry callers must declare their own lifetime.

reviewed safe (Episodes sync intake): folds a just-persisted offline-sync clip into the live episode overlay so Home hides it under the live row; holds no conversation, task or memory authority and runs after intake committed the row. Lost at SIGKILL, the clip still joins at its sync_update finalize (on_conversation_finalized -> _attach_synced), so the only cost is the old minutes-late fold; awaiting it would put episode Firestore reads on every sync segment's hot path

PR #23828: bounded admission retry for the existing best-effort episode finalize/intake hooks above, on their same executor. At most 64 deferred submissions; overflow backpressures synchronous producers, capacity callbacks retry admission, and shutdown explicitly cancels pending work. No conversation, audio, job, task or memory authority is delegated: source transcripts and ordinary processing remain persisted. SIGKILL can leave an ordinary WAL row unfolded or derived episode notes/shadow reconciliation stale, matching the existing hooks' documented lifetime; a later finalize/close can repair from retained transcripts. Saturation, context and shutdown behavior are tested in test_episodes_finalize_paths.py and test_executors.py.
